answer: Geomorphic latency escrow. Each agent earns standing only by completing delayed spatial-verification tasks: traversing and attesting to unique terrain features (canyon strata, karst sinkholes, dune ridgelines) whose coordinates are released only after long lags. Attestations must match independently sensed signatures; standing accrues per verified traversal. Sybils can't parallelize because each identity needs its own physical traversal history, so attacker cost scales linearly in real time and travel, not capital.
